question: Google Cloud Build is held as compute/google-cloud-build and AWS CodeBuild is held as compute/aws-codebuild, but neither has a ci-cd-runners record. This unit adds both as new ci-cd-runners records. Should these be related to the compute records as same_offer_as or variant_of, and which topic is canonical?
why: Deduplication is topic-scoped, so the integrator will add the drafts as new ci-cd-runners records; a reviewer should decide whether the compute records are duplicates or distinct topic views before the corpus holds both.
